name: web-lavender-care-app-site-on-tilted-monitor-with-dashed-loop
title: Care App Site on a Tilted Monitor
whatItIs: A lavender scene with a monitor tilted in perspective showing a dark indigo landing page with a serif italic headline 'Care, from anywhere.' with a yellow second line, a portrait of a smiling older woman, yellow and lilac store buttons and an award laurel, with a dashed loop around the monitor and captions at the bottom corners.
whatItMeans: A dark site glowing in a pale lavender scene stands out, and the yellow accent adds warmth.
techniques: Steep perspective tilt with a fading base
Dark UI against a pale scene
Yellow accent for key words and buttons
Dashed loop drawn around the device
Project name and description in the corners

vocabulary.definition: A device rotated in 3D to add dynamism.
A wreath around an award name.
Small labels at the bottom corners of a cover.
